title: A Second Day of Weekend Gains for Crypto
lede: Crypto drifted higher again on Sunday, with Bitcoin up 1.75% and Ether up 2.3%, as the market steadied after Friday's rout. Sentiment, however, never left extreme fear.

paras: Bitcoin added 1.75% to close the weekend at $61,271, and Ether rose 2.30% to $1,724. Two green days repaired some of Friday's damage, but prices remained well below the week's opening levels.
